description: Deletes a specific comment from a Figma file or branch, provided the authenticated user is the original author of the comment.

inputSchema.description: Defines the parameters required to delete a comment from a Figma file.

comment_id.description: The unique string identifier of the comment to be deleted. This ID can be obtained from the response of `GET /v1/files/:file_key/comments` or from the response when creating a comment with `POST /v1/files/:file_key/comments`. Only the author of the comment can delete it.
comment_id.title: Comment Id

file_key.description: The key of the Figma file or branch from which the comment will be deleted. This can be a file key (typically found in the file's URL, e.g., 'sFHgQh9dL6369o5wrZHmdR' from https://www.figma.com/design/sFHgQh9dL6369o5wrZHmdR/...) or a branch key. To obtain a branch key, use the `GET /v1/files/:key` endpoint with the `branch_data` query parameter.
file_key.title: File Key

inputSchema.title: DeleteACommentRequest

name: delete_a_comment

DeleteACommentResponse.description: Defines the structure of the response received after successfully deleting a comment.

data.description: Contains the outcome of the comment deletion, including HTTP status code and error indicator.
data.title: Data

DeleteACommentResponse.title: DeleteACommentResponse

error.description: Indicates if an error occurred. For successful deletions, this value is `false`.
error.title: Error

i18n.description: Internationalization data, typically null for delete operations.
i18n.title: I18N

status.description: The HTTP status code of the request. A value of 200 indicates the comment was successfully deleted.
status.title: Status
